AC amendment: Add standard universal criteria verify commands and RED marker requirement.

## Acceptance Criteria (supplemental)

Universal Criteria:
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(grep 'commands.lint' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/dso-config.conf" | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d ' "') && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: true  # shell test file — no ruff format check required

Script/Tooling Criteria:
- [ ] test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh
- [ ] All 5 named test scenarios exist in the test file
  Verify: grep -c 'test_\|@test' tests/scripts/test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 5)}'
- [ ] Tests FAIL before Task 2 (detect-cleanup-recipes.sh) is implemented
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh 2>&1; test $? -ne 0
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_detect_cleanup_recipes_python] for detect-cleanup-recipes.sh
  Verify: grep -q '\[test_detect_cleanup_recipes' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"

Failure mode coverage:
- [ ] Test covers: RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH missing → graceful exit (exit 1 or empty output, no crash)
  Verify: RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH=/nonexistent bash tests/scripts/test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh 2>&1 | grep -qiE 'registry|not found|missing' || bash tests/scripts/test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh 2>&1; true

Given/When/Then test approach:
- Given: a mock recipe registry at RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH with normalize-imports entries for python/typescript/ruby
- When: detect-cleanup-recipes.sh is invoked with a diff containing .py files with unsorted imports
- Then: script outputs 'normalize-imports' for python language (exit 0); --format=json outputs JSON array
